 AMD: Buy As Data Center Revenue Expands On Challenger Status
 Nov 11, 2026, 8:56 AM ET Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) Stock , AMD:CA Stock , ZAMD:CA Stock 18 Comments Index Analyst 52 Followers Follow Summary
 I rate AMD a Buy, targeting a fair value of $562.5 by December 2027.
 My valuation applies a 22.5x multiple to 2028 EPS estimates, aligning with peer averages.
 The investment thesis hinges on AMD's data center segment, with revenues nearly doubling YoY in Q3 2026.
 Management expects continued data center revenue doubling, supporting substantial upside from current price levels.
 Getty Images
 Thesis
 I rate AMD ( AMD ) as a Buy. Applying 22.5x to my calendar 2028 EPS estimate of $25 gives a fair value of $562.5 around December 2027, and that's roughly 25% above the current price levels. Peers trade between 20x and 25x
